required_fields.probability_raster_path: Path to single-band flood probability GeoTIFF
required_fields.mask_raster_path: Path to single-band binary flood mask GeoTIFF

optional_fields.acquisition_timestamp: ISO-8601 datetime with timezone or null
optional_fields.crs: Declared CRS string; validated against raster CRS when provided

validation: Both rasters must contain exactly one band.
Both rasters must have a CRS.
Both rasters must have matching CRS, transform, width and height.
Valid probabilities must be between 0 and 1.
Valid mask values must be 0 or 1.
The binary mask must match probability >= threshold.
At least one overlapping valid pixel must exist.

required_fields.risk_category: low, moderate, high, very_high or unavailable

validation: Environmental score must be numeric or null.
Non-null scores must be between 0 and 100.
Risk category must match the score.
Prediction timestamp must include a timezone.

inputs.fusion_timestamp: Optional ISO-8601 datetime with timezone; defaults to current UTC time

satellite_inundation.acquisition_timestamp: ISO-8601 datetime with timezone or null

output.overall_status: both_sources_available, satellite_only, environmental_only, insufficient_data or temporal_validation_required

fusion_rules: Keep satellite inundation and environmental risk as separate evidence streams.
Never blindly average the two model outputs.
Never produce an uncalibrated combined flood probability or overall risk score.
Preserve missing input and source uncertainty information.
Validate raster CRS, dimensions, transforms and geospatial alignment.
Validate consistency between the satellite probability raster and binary mask.
Do not claim satellite freshness without a validated freshness threshold.
Do not infer acquisition time from filesystem modification time.
Flag future satellite inference timestamps for temporal validation.
Do not infer ward-level inundation without appropriate spatial analysis.
Satellite raster statistics describe overlapping valid pixels only.
known_limitations: Satellite freshness threshold has not been validated.
Filesystem modification time is not a verified inference or acquisition timestamp.
Spatial and temporal alignment between satellite and environmental evidence has not been established.
Real-data integration has currently been validated using satellite-only input.
Environmental risk baseline is experimental and has not been validated against independent flood-event ground truth.
Flooded pixel fraction applies only to valid raster coverage, not the entire Chennai study area.
